name: Overture TPU 95A @CORE One L HF0.4 - 3D3D
compatible_printers: Prusa CORE One L HF 0.4 nozzle - 3D3D
Prusa CORE One L HF 0.4 nozzle
filament_notes: 3D3D 2026-09-30, first pass for Overture black TPU on the Core One L HF0.4. Stock Orca 'Overture TPU @System' is a Bambu profile (220 C, 8 mm3/s, flow 0.95, 0.4 mm retract): cold + fast = gaps between lines, too little retract = strings. Tune from here: flow 1.02-1.08, 230-245 C, 3-5 mm3/s, retract 1-2.5 mm. Dry the spool first (50 C, 6-8 h). No z-hop, no ironing.
